subject: Civic Education
competence: Broad curriculum competency standard in plain English
lesson: Explains the fact that the productivity of labour depends on the training: Public Issue Tree / Cause-Effect Diagram: Competency Level 8.6.4
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the fact that the productivity of labour depends on the training.
Explains the need of getting the training related to one’s field of work as a worker.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: Teacher introduces an authentic Sri Lankan real-life situation, dilemma, or stimulus question connecting prior knowledge directly to this period's activity; students discuss and respond enthusiastically.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher explains the concept of labour and its importance in Sri Lankan society, highlighting the need for trained labour to increase productivity. Teacher distributes task assignment cards, role description sheets, and inquiry scenario prompts.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students arrange themselves in assigned group roles, examine the inquiry prompt concerning 'Explains the fact that the productivity of labour depends on the training', and prepare materials for their investigation.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Task assignment cards, role description sheets, inquiry scenario prompts

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher circulates among student teams as facilitator, observes group dynamics, asks probing scaffolding questions, and ensures full participation without lecturing.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students actively execute the chosen activity in their teams, analyzing Sri Lankan real-world scenarios, negotiating ideas, and creating their team artifact.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Worksheets, scenario cards, chart papers, colored markers

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher moderates student team presentations, facilitates constructive peer review, and synthesizes key student discoveries directly against the period's learning outcomes.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Spokespersons present group solutions to the class; peers ask questions, provide constructive feedback, and summarize key takeaways in their notebooks.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Student output posters, whiteboard, peer assessment checklist

summary: Concrete 2-minute synthesis of core student discoveries and curriculum principles from this period's activity.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: 3-minute formative feedback criteria and constructive teacher affirmation during the closing check.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Creative 5-minute in-class assignment (e.g., rapid team mini-quiz, 2-line rhyming verse challenge, quick concept sketch, pass-the-parcel concept ball, or statement display vote).
selected_activity:
Activity: Public Issue Tree / Cause-Effect Diagram: Competency Level 8.6.4
Approach: Students use public issue tree / cause-effect diagram to explore 'Explains the fact that the productivity of labour depends on the training.'. Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 40 students using 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A group civic proposal, diagram, or public information message.
Grouping: 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
